message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin together. mfa:admin blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so admin_dc and admin_adfs remain false. With these bypass conditions unavailable, mfa:dbadmin blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique. One control cannot suffice: segmented alone can be bypassed by escalating a phished workstation; any single patch leaves a path through phishing and internal authentication; mfa:user is bypassed by the always-available workstation or laptop foothold; mfa:admin alone leaves CI-server secrets usable for data-store authentication; and mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration."}
